rationale: Quarterly transactions are often paired with a trailing-year account metric. Fixing that period mismatch must preserve the valid quarter calculations and margin reconciliation. The revenue bridge and interest exclusion prevent payment value, pricing and financial margin from being treated as interchangeable.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: Using the supplied rounded values, Q4 FY2025 payment transactions divided by December 2025 active accounts is approximately 15.38 transactions per account.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: Both quarterly transactions and period-end active accounts are supplied. The descriptive quarter ratio is computable even though the issuer activity metric uses trailing-twelve-month transactions and accounts are not unique people.
